# telnyx_custom_storage_credential (Data Source)

Credentials for storing call recordings of a connection in your own AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage or Azure bucket.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) The connection id.

### Read-Only

- `backend` (String) One of `azure`, `gcs`, `s3`, `s3-generic`.
- `configuration` (String, Sensitive) A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
